break_axe_01.text: The axe handle snapped. It went down swinging, as advertised.

break_flashlight_01.text: The flashlight flickered, weighed its options, and chose darkness.

break_padlock_01.text: The padlock gave out. It's just door jewellery now.

break_radio_01.text: The radio's last words were a mattress commercial.

day_start_01.text: Day {n}. The sun came up on schedule. It's the only thing that did.

day_start_02.text: No new notifications. There won't be.

day_start_03.text: The shelter smells of canned peaches and unresolved arguments.

day_start_04.text: Somewhere, a calendar app is still reminding someone about the dentist.

death_01.text: They're gone. The shelter got quieter, and nobody wanted that.

death_02.text: They didn't come back. Their spot by the radio stays empty a while.

death_03.text: Their phone is still at four percent, waiting.

death_04.text: We lost one today. The jokes can wait until tomorrow.

success_01.text: Back with supplies, and only a mild glow.

success_02.text: Everyone ate today. Write it down; it may be a record.

success_03.text: The plan worked. Nobody knows what to do with this feeling.
